name: 香草奶油调温和沐浴露款
description: 香芋紫渐变与奶油质感串联的八镜身体清洁转化套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating fields: seamless packshot white #FFFFFF, cream info surface #F4EEE4, and a smooth lavender gradient scene field from #C3B2E6 to #A99AD6
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, large front-left softbox key with a white fill card, soft contact shadows, single controlled gloss highlight on wet or gelled surfaces, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy reflective shelf ledge for display shots, matte cream stone slab for texture and macro shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif layout type only; every wording slot stays an empty placeholder frame in this template
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line bubble-and-sparkle icons in one accent color #E13C86, no filled or 3D icons, no seal artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: upright bottle with a consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on scale across the set, label plane always facing the camera, props and hands never covering the product silhouette
noDrift: no serif or script display lettering
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium body-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, soft cream #F4EEE4, diffuse lavender scene field #B7A6DE and one magenta accent #E13C86; neutral-cool studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, a white fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif layout type with all wording kept as empty placeholder frames; consistent thin-line bubble icon style in a single accent color; backgrounds alternate between clean white, cream and lavender fields; stable upright product scale and centring across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no source brand marks.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净的翻盖瓶正身拿走首图流量
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle upright and centered, whole silhouette inside the frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with a white fill card, soft contact shadow under the base
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with a faint glossy white floor plane
shots.whitespace: none beyond an even margin around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle stands upright, photographed straight-on at eye level with the whole silhouette inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio light from a large front-left softbox with a white fill card on the shadow side, and a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with a faint glossy white floor plane. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, centered, with no extra whitespace beyond an even margin around the silhouette. Crisp edges, true matte bottle shoulder and translucent flip-cap rendering, square marketplace main-image framing. Negative: no props, no hands, no rendered wording or lettering, no badge or award artwork, no rating stars, no watermark, no fake logo, no tinted or gradient background, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off cap or base.

shots.intent: 一秒传达甜点感香氛主张，用香调道具承接首图情绪
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, bottle on the right third, bubbles floating upper right
shots.lighting: diffuse front-left softbox key with a cool lavender wash behind the product, faint gloss on a reflective floor
shots.props: two dried vanilla pods, one open white blossom, a small cluster of soap bubbles
shots.whitespace: generous clean negative space on the left 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} on a lavender mood field. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 angle with the bottle on the right third, a cluster of foam bubbles drifting at the upper right, and two dried vanilla pods with one open white blossom resting at its base. Diffuse front-left softbox key with a cool lavender wash behind the product, faint mirror reflection on a glossy lavender floor #B7A6DE. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous clean negative space on the left 40% reserved for later copy. Cosy dessert-like fragrance mood carried purely by props and light. Negative: no rendered text or lettering, no brand marks, no visible face, no foam hiding the bottle silhouette, no plastic-looking botanicals, no bubbles whose highlights contradict the front-left light direction.

shots.intent: 用俯视微距质地与三段空白香调框解释气味结构
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the upper left modelling the ripple ridges, soft shadow in the grooves
shots.props: two dried vanilla pods and one white blossom laid diagonally, three empty rounded pill frames with leader lines
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, of a thick creamy swatch swept in ridge-like waves across a matte cream stone slab #F4EEE4, with two dried vanilla pods and one open white blossom laid diagonally across it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Skimming side light from the upper left modelling the ripple ridges, shallow depth of field with the pod surface sharp and the slab edge softening. Three blank rounded pill frames with thin outlines sit on the swatch as unlabeled callout placeholders, each joined to a botanical element by a short leader line. The textured detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace. Negative: no readable wording inside the pill frames, no brand marks, no product bottle in frame, no invented note list or numeric data, no greasy plastic sheen on the cream, no blurry subject, no duplicated botanicals.

shots.intent: 以冲洗中的身体泡沫给买家自我代入，并用空白主张位承接信任点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at shoulder height, mid-shot cropped from the collar down so no face appears
shots.lighting: soft front-left studio key over a lavender field, warm skin micro-highlights, soft contact shadow
shots.props: dense soft lather on the forearm, three thin-line bubble icons with blank label bars
shots.whitespace: clean negative space on the right 35% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: a generic adult model, cropped from the collar downward so that no face is visible, turning a forearm streaked with dense soft lather toward the camera while {product} stands at the lower edge of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera at a slight 3/4 angle at shoulder height in a mid-shot on the shoulder and arm. Soft front-left studio key over a smooth lavender gradient field #C3B2E6, warm skin micro-highlights, soft contact shadow where the arm rests. Three thin-line bubble icons with blank label bars sit in the right column as an unlabeled proof row. The model and the product together occupy 40-50% of the frame, with clean negative space on the right 35% for copy. Negative: no identifiable face or eyes, no deformed or extra fingers, no over-smoothed plastic skin, no readable wording on the label bars, no medical or clinical imagery, no water droplets contradicting the light direction, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用侧影倾倒的连贯凝胶线证明奶油凝胶质地而非稀薄液体
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile of the upturned bottle entering from the upper right, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: large softbox key front-left plus a narrow skimming highlight catching the gel gloss
shots.background: pale lilac-white field #EFE9F7 with a faint mirror reflection under the pool
shots.props: open flip cap, one continuous gel ribbon, a small pooled mound below
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Macro close-up from a clean 90-degree side profile: a thick translucent gel ribbon pours in one continuous vertical line from the upturned neck of {product}, whose open flip cap hangs at the top edge, down onto a small slow pool below. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Large softbox key from the front-left plus a narrow skimming highlight that catches the gloss of the gel, shallow depth of field with the pour line sharp. Pale lilac-white backdrop #EFE9F7 with a faint mirror reflection beneath the pool. The bottle neck and the pour occupy 55-60% of the frame, with generous negative space on the left 40% for copy. Negative: no splashes or drips outside the pool, no foam bubbles in the gel, no readable label wording, no brand marks, no hands, no bottle floating without a visible support or entry edge, no water-mark artefacts.

shots.intent: 以高角度使用步骤降低用法疑虑，编号位保持空白可替换
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the hands and limb, head fully out of frame
shots.lighting: soft window-style daylight key from the left at 5500K, wet-skin micro-highlights, soft contact shadow
shots.props: mesh puff ball, damp skin with lather, two small blank numbered circles at the left edge
shots.whitespace: clear negative space on the lower left for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Step-by-step usage scene, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down: two hands working a mesh puff ball into a soft lather over damp skin, head and face entirely outside the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft window-style daylight key from the left at 5500K with gentle bounce, wet-skin micro-highlights, and a soft contact shadow where the limb rests on the surface. Smooth lavender field #B7A6DE behind. Two small blank numbered circles sit along the left edge as unlabeled step placeholders. The hands, puff and skin occupy 40-50% of the frame with clear negative space on the lower left for copy. Negative: no deformed or fused fingers, no visible face, no readable step wording, no towel or bottle clutter covering the hands, no over-retouched airbrushed skin, no duplicated hands, no watermark.

shots.intent: 把单品扩成可搭配的 trio 组合，用引线空白框做无字样说明
shots.camera: straight-on eye level, three units of descending height in a staggered row
shots.lighting: even front softbox key with a fill card, identical light direction on all three units, soft contact shadows beneath each base
shots.background: glossy cream shelf ledge #F4EEE4 with a lavender wash behind
shots.props: three coordinating units, thin leader lines to three blank label frames, a few soap bubbles at the left base
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 25% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce routine set screen: {product} presented as three coordinating units of descending height standing in a staggered row on a glossy cream shelf ledge #F4EEE4, photographed straight-on at eye level. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even front softbox key with a white fill card, identical light direction and shadow length on all three units, soft contact shadows beneath each base, a diffuse lavender wash behind the row. Thin leader lines rise from each cap to three small blank label frames kept free of wording, and a few soap bubbles gather at the left base. The trio occupies 50-60% of the frame overall, with generous negative space across the top 25% for copy. Negative: no readable text on the label frames, no invented product names, no duplicated identical bottles, no mixed lighting between units, no brand marks, no floating items without contact shadows, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以整列香型与底部空白信任位收口，去掉任何徽章与星级
shots.camera: very low angle looking slightly upward at two stacked glass shelves so the rows read clean
shots.lighting: bright even front light with a soft top fill, gentle sheen on the glass ledges, no harsh speculars
shots.props: a row of tinted bottles on two glass shelves, one soft cleansing brush at the right, scattered foam bubbles, a row of six empty thin-line seal frames on the lower band
shots.whitespace: clear negative space across the bottom band for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and range screen, photographed from a very low angle looking slightly upward: a row of tinted units of {product} arranged on two stacked transparent glass shelves, one soft cleansing brush resting at the right end of the lower shelf and a few foam bubbles scattered along the ledges. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even front light with a soft top fill, gentle sheen along the glass edges and no harsh speculars, over a lavender-to-pale-blue gradient field #A99AD6. The full display occupies 35-40% of the frame overall, leaving clear negative space across the bottom band where a row of six empty thin-line seal frames sits as blank proof placeholders. Negative: no readable wording or glyph inside the seal frames, no award badge or laurel artwork, no stars or rating graphics, no certification artwork, no duplicated bottles, no mixed lighting between shelves, no warped straight lines on the glass edges, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 源为 8 张 1024px 方图。逐图事实：01 近白底翻盖瓶正面 packshot，标签上有字标、系列名、容量数字与两枚小图标；02 香芋紫渐变氛围图，瓶身偏右，香草荚＋白花＋泡沫气泡道具，左上衬线大标题；03 俯视微距，奶油刮纹台面上斜放香草荚与白花，三枚胶囊框分别标注前调中调尾调；04 模特微笑露脸、手臂覆泡沫，右侧三行图标＋主张；05 翻盖开启的瓶口倾倒奶油凝胶侧影，左侧标题＋两行图标主张；06 高角度手部用起泡球在湿润肌肤上打泡，编号 1/2 步骤说明；07 三只不同高度的同系列瓶成排，引线标签指向盖顶；08 双层玻璃架八色香型色卡陈列，右上奖项圆章，底部六枚无添加图标行。品类判定依据：图内为冲洗型身体清洁（翻盖瓶倾倒凝胶、全身肌肤打泡、起泡球使用步骤），非留香型身体乳，故 L2 取表内「身体清洁」而非提示的「身体护理」，L1 仍为护肤个护；源平台类目路径未采用。08 虽为色卡陈列，但仅作 VARIANT/TRUST 素材，全套仍有完整转化分镜，故不作变体画廊跳过。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、瓶身与图内的容量与百分比数字、配方参数类主张（酸碱度、无添加清单、经临床验证类字样）、奖项圆章与星级、底部图标文字、全部图内英文文案原句、模特面容与身份（第 4 镜改为颈部以下裁切的通用成人模特）；主张位统一改为空白胶囊框、空白编号圈、空白印章框与留空指示条，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
